latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video AI Editor — fast, no-hassle AI-powered video editing and export.

- Upload raw video (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB) and specify desired edits or export instructions.
- AI-powered editor handles tasks like removing pauses, adding background music, and exporting as 1080p MP4.
- Simple onboarding: automatically obtains and reuses tokens for easy session creation; shows connection status.
- Intuitive prompt-based control—no need to learn complex software or interfaces.
- Export jobs render via cloud GPU; download links provided on completion.
- Automatic error handling for common issues (file type, size, session, credits).
